messages:
andrea-marketing: Quick pre-launch SEO checklist for the Redwood launch next Tue — need quick confirmations on: keyword mapping, schema (WebinarEvent + FAQ), internal links, redirects, and canonical for the webinar landing. Can we triage now?

sam-seo: I started a KW map -> https://docs.google.com/sheet/XXX (editing rights). I'll slice primary/secondary and intent. Will add target CTAs per page.

lucy-content: I'll draft the launch post meta (title/meta desc) + 2 headline variants. Want the primary KW from sam before I finalize. Also planning 3 in-post internal links to docs/pricing/benchmarks.

mike-analytics: Add UTM templates for the webinar links: `?utm_source=launch_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=redwood_launch_v1`. Also GA4 event names: `webinar_signup`, `webinar_start`, `webinar_complete`. I'll add GTM snippet to the staging page for validation.

ravi-dev: Redirect question — should we manage 301s at CDN (Fastly) or via app router (Next)? I prefer CDN-level so we avoid JS hops. Example rule we can deploy at CDN: `match ^/old-path/(.*) -> /new-path/$1 301`.

jess-marketing: :thumbsup: Also: webinar landing canonical should be the clean URL `/webinars/redwood-launch` to avoid querystring duplicates. And yes, we need WebinarEvent JSON-LD on the landing.

andrea-marketing: Schema — can someone paste a minimal WebinarEvent JSON-LD we can drop into head? Keep it small, include startDate, endDate, organizer, url, and offers (free). We want crawlers to pick it up.

sam-seo: Sure — minimal example (replace placeholders):
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "WebinarEvent",
  "name": "Redwood Inference Launch Demo",
  "startDate": "2026-03-24T16:00:00-07:00",
  "endDate": "2026-03-24T17:00:00-07:00",
  "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinars/redwood-launch",
  "organizer": {
    "@type": "Organization",
    "name": "Redwood Inference"
  },
  "offers": {
    "@type": "Offer",
    "price": "0",
    "priceCurrency": "USD"
  }
}
```

lucy-content: I'll add a small FAQ schema for the launch post (3 Qs) and wire internal links to the docs + benchmarks page. Also will provide H1/H2 variants in the doc for A/B copy.

mike-analytics: For tracking redirects we should append a small query param on redirect destinations so we can validate, e.g. `/?src=launchemail`. Also enable GTM debug mode on staging and send me access.

ravi-dev: I pushed a staging redirect set. Examples for static hosts: Netlify `_redirects` line -> `/old-path/*  /new-path/:splat  301!` or Vercel rewrites/redirects in `vercel.json`. I tested a sample 301, working on the full list.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Staging updated: redirect-rules-2026-03-18 (build 572) — https://staging.redwood.ai/ — checks: redirects OK, sitemap rebuilt.

andrea-marketing: Great. Action items: sam finalize KW sheet by EOD, lucy finalize meta + add FAQ schema, ravi confirm live 301s on prod (CDN preferred), mike add GA4 events + UTMs to the webinar links, jess confirm canonical + page-level structured data. Check-in tomorrow 9:30 PT. Thanks everyone :rocket:
